caseName: Carpenter v. Superior Court of California
caseNameFull: Carpenter v. Superior Court of California in and for the County of Los Angeles
attorneys: Mr. A. L. Wirin for petitioners. Mr. W. B. McKesson for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to use the record in Carpenter v. Hamilton, 311 U. S. 656, is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of California is denied.
